registered_request_budget.derivation: one send reservation per planned box at most; failure ends order; no retry; unused sends do not permit extra jobs

retrieval_rule.distance: mean absolute normalized feature distance; score=1/(1+distance)

historical_result_budget.interpretation: same observed outcome fields for future T/E; equal bytes do not establish fairness

retrieval_rule.scales: container dimensions, payload; capacity uses max(payload,1); placed volume/container volume
retrieval_rule.truncation: whole entries only; never remove conditions, costs or limitations

information_budget.differences: T normalized historical location detail; E hypotheses and evidence counts; equal caps do not establish information equivalence

historical_result.interpretation: same observed outcome fields for future T/E; equal bytes do not establish fairness

cost_accounting: current native request ledger only; historical calls not counted as C jobs; billed USD UNKNOWN; no inferred bill
